## What it catches

A loose file in a package's `src/` other than `index.ts`, `facade.ts`, `storage.ts`.

## As `layout({ scope: "@hosti/" })` builds it

```json
{
  "name": "package-root-files",
  "severity": "error",
  "module": {
    "path": "^packages/[^/]+/src/[^/]+$",
    "pathNot": [
      "^packages/[^/]+/src/(?:index[.]ts|facade[.]ts|storage[.]ts)$",
      "(?:^|/)(?:tests?|__tests__)(?:/|$)|[.](?:test|spec)[.][^/]+$"
    ],
    "numberOfDependentsLessThan": 100
  },
  "from": {}
}
```
